# Stage P-bis — Miliarium pool seeding transaction ledger

Chain 11155111. Broadcaster `0xA851478dbee97375E784e9b98c0D7D599662bF85`, the deployer EOA rather than the multisig per PB-D46, because initialization is permissionless and its caller becomes the pool first BPT holder. On Sepolia those are the same address per PB-D23 (iv).

The complete per-transaction ledger for the `SeedMiliariumPoolsSepolia` run that capitalised all 26 Miliarium Aureum pools. Generated from `broadcast/SeedMiliariumPoolsSepolia.s.sol/11155111/run-latest.json` rather than transcribed, and regenerating it must reproduce this file byte for byte. `broadcast/` is gitignored, so this is the committed record of what that artifact holds. Narrative, aggregates and the on-chain TVL verification are in `docs/STAGE_P_BIS_SEPOLIA_DEPLOYMENT_RECORD.md` section 13.

The arguments column records the seeding amounts as actually sent, so the authored allocation table in `script/config/MiliariumSeedAllocations.sol` can be checked against the chain by a later reader with no RPC access. That table is authored rather than derived, so this ledger is the only external evidence of what it produced.

Transactions 389, receipts 389, every one successful. Nonces 301 to 689, contiguous. Blocks 11405061 to 11405532. Total gas 33,643,685. Breakdown: approve 177, mint 127, deposit 59, initialize 26.
